title: Governance Mapping
description: Schema for capability-level governance rules for a UK commercial bank

id.description: Unique governance mapping identifier in format GOV-XXX

capability_id.description: Reference to the capability this governance mapping covers

rule_id.description: Unique rule identifier scoped to the capability

name.description: Short name of the governance rule

source_legislation.description: The regulation, directive, or rule source underpinning this requirement

description.description: Full description of the rule and its compliance obligations

authority_level.description: Lowest authority level required to approve exceptions or policy changes

approval_chain.description: Ordered list of roles that must approve policy changes or material exceptions

disclosure_obligations.description: Mandatory disclosure or reporting obligations triggered by or associated with this rule

constraints.description: Hard limits, thresholds, or prohibitions imposed by this rule
